home.text: +44(0)1420487788 home | about us | products | datasheets | account home AX-LDPSTXL : The AX-LSPSTXL is an electronic pressure switch with a volt-free contact output for use in HVAC applications. Available from 500mBar till 100Bar Differential Pressure. AX-GS-CD-T81G : Completely new range of Room/Space CO2 Transmitter. Comes with Analogue and MODBUS outputs along with Non Display and Multi Color LCD options. AX-RA : AXIO Damper Actuators are available in Modulating, On/Off, Spring Return & Fire Spring Return. With IP54 Protection and Selectable Auxilary Switch and Mechanical Adjustment Option AX-HL : Hydrostatic Level Transmitter (Submersible), 4-20mA/0-10V Output, 0.25%FS Accuracy, IP54 & IP68, PVC & PTFE Cable Options. AX-OC-CMPF : Infrared sensor detects movements of persons, large animals and vehicles in a detection range of up to 6m with a detection angle of 360° (on free area) and switches on the connected lighting. AX-CNDR-x : Digital Room Controller. Clear blue display. Analogue or relay options. Window and key card inputs. PI control actions. Isolated MSTP BACnet version available. AX-CSL : Current Switch - Solid & Split Core. The AX-CSL series of current switches is designed for versatility and convenience in monitoring AC currents. With the ability to handle currents up to 200A, these switches offer both solid-core and split-core options to suit different installation needs. AX-LSPTA : Completely new range of pressure transmitters for liquids and non-agressive gases. Available in a wide array of pressure ranges and supporting either 4-20mA or 0-10Vdc outputs. AX-LCD-2 : Dual LCD Meter mounted on single gang, white plastic plate. Various options allow a 0-10V or 4-20mA input to be displayed in a variety of temperature ranges and other measurement units. AXIO Web Catalogue Our Catalogue is available. If you require a printed copy please contact our sales team sales@annicom.com . ANNICOM has been established as a design and build company for the Industrial Controls, HVAC, and Building Automation Industry for more than 40 years. Alongside its own range of high quality products under the " Axio " brand name it also designs and manufactures controls for many of the industry giants on an OEM basis, including such companies as Siemens, Honeywell, JCI, UTS Carrier. etc .
